description: Emits a structured audit entry to .ai/logs/ for any agent action. Called after every apply-safe-change, heartbeat, and reflect-and-improve invocation.
checklist: 1. Determine today's log file path: .ai/logs/YYYY-MM-DD-session.md (use current date)
2. Create the file if it does not exist; write a header: '# Agent Session Log — YYYY-MM-DD'
3. Append the entry using the format from agent-config.yaml log_format section

4. Required fields: timestamp (ISO 8601), action (brief description), files_affected (list of relative paths or []), safety_level (low|medium|high), approval_obtained (true|false|n/a), outcome (success|skipped|failed)
5. Never log credential values, secrets, or sensitive content — log only file paths and action descriptions
